_readme: This file is REFERENCE DATA, not a price feed. It records which markets exist, on which
exchange, and how each fact was verified. It contains no prices and no liquidity figures.
verified        - the contract-specification table was read on the official product page
during this project and the quoted fields below are copied from it
listed_only     - the exchange's own product navigation (or category page) proves the
product code and spec page exist; the individual field values were NOT
read in this session and are therefore left null
unverified      - the market is known to exist in the industry but no official page was
confirmed in this session, so nothing is claimed beyond that
automated_official_api   - this project pulls prices for it from the exchange's own API
historical_only          - official historical prices exist; the series has been discontinued
licensed_feed_required   - the exchange blocks automated access; a licensed feed is needed
endpoint_unresolved      - a public endpoint exists but its parameters/terms are unresolved
Every entry carries the official URL a human reviewer can open to check it.

cme.name: CME Group
cme.automated_access_evidence: Automated requests from GitHub Actions receive HTTP 403: 'This IP address is blocked due to suspected web scraping activity... Use of scripts, software, spiders, robots, avatars, agents, tools or other scraping mechanisms is strictly prohibited by CME Group's website Data Terms of Use.' (verified 2026-09-22)
cme.note: Contract specifications below were read from official CME Group product pages. Prices are not automated: a CME-licensed feed is required for that, so no CME market is priced in the simulation.

ice.name: ICE (Intercontinental Exchange)
ice.automated_access_evidence: https://www.ice.com/report/10 returned a click-through page stating end-of-day report packages in .csv format are available for purchase on a subscription basis (verified 2026-09-22).
ice.note: Soft commodities (coffee, cocoa, sugar, cotton, FCOJ) and Brent crude are ICE-listed. No free official price API was found, so these markets are catalogued but not priced.

lme.name: London Metal Exchange
lme.automated_access_evidence: https://www.lme.com/api/prices returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge (verified 2026-09-22).

moex.name: Moscow Exchange (MOEX), FORTS derivatives market
moex.automated_access_evidence: Keyless ISS endpoints returned HTTP 200 for the contract list (503 contracts), individual contract quotes and daily history (verified 2026-09-22).
moex.note: This is the only futures exchange besides Kalshi whose live quotes this project can price trades from. Contracts are discovered live from the exchange listing; the codes below are the ones the exchange actually publishes.

listing_evidence_2026_09_22.palladium: NO palladium asset code exists in the FORTS listing (P codes are PLT/PLTM platinum and PLD/PLDM/PLZLM equities) - verified 2026-09-22. The watchlist keeps PALL as a documented request; nothing is traded under it.
non_commodity_sectors_verified: equity indexes (MIX, RTS, NASD, SPYF, DJ30, DAX, NIKK, R2000, STOX, HANG and others)
FX (Si, CNY, Eu, GBPU, AUDU, UJPY and others)
perpetual-style continuous contracts (USDRUBF, GLDRUBF, SLVRUBF, BTCUSDF and others)
